source: KV Berlin Terminservice 116117, KBV Arzt- und Psychotherapeutensuche, Terminservice- und Versorgungsgesetz

needs.label: Skin
needs.note: Dermatology is one of the groups that must hold open hours every week.

needs.label: Back, knee, joints
needs.note: Orthopaedics must hold open hours, and it is the specialty Berliners queue for longest.

needs.label: Nerves, migraine
needs.note: Neurology must hold open hours. Bring anything an earlier doctor wrote down.

needs.label: Ear, nose, throat
needs.note: ENT must hold open hours, which is why a blocked ear on a Monday is often walk-in work.

needs.label: Urology
needs.note: Urology must hold open hours every week.

needs.label: Eyes
needs.note: Eyes need no referral at all for the booking service, and the practice must also hold open hours.

needs.label: Gynaecology
needs.note: Gynaecology needs no referral for the booking service, and must hold open hours.

needs.label: A child
needs.note: Paediatrics needs no referral, and the booking service also places the U check-ups.

needs.label: Heart
needs.note: Cardiology sits outside the open-hours list, so the coded referral is the whole game.

needs.label: Therapy, first talk
needs.note: A first psychotherapy consultation is placed without a referral. Acute sessions need a coded report from a therapist instead.

needs.label: Teeth
needs.note: Dentists and orthodontists sit outside the booking service completely. No paper you hold changes that.

routes.name: Ring the practice yourself
routes.line: No ceiling and no promise. In exchange you pick the practice, and you can ask on the phone whether they work in English.

routes.name: 116117 booking service, online
routes.line: Four weeks at the outside, a practice you do not choose, and language is not a field the service can honour.

routes.name: 116117 booking service, by phone
routes.line: The same four-week ceiling, answered day and night. Use it when the online path cannot read your paper.

routes.name: Sit in the open hours
routes.line: Every full practice in these groups owes five open hours a week with no appointment. You pick the door, you pay in waiting time.

routes.name: 116117 on-call doctor
routes.line: Same day, but only for something that cannot wait. It is not a shortcut into a routine specialist queue.
